fact: On 5 December 2024 the regulator ARPCE's director general said the country had two major submarine cables, WACS in operation since 2012 and 2Africa in service in 2024, the latter landing at a station managed by Airtel Congo.
title: Congo/Télécommunications : Vers l'intégration du câble sous-marin 2Africa pour renforcer la connectivité du pays
